fusions.name: Settling Silt
fusions.desc: A heavy settling of silt deals 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 8 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Ponderous Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a clod of reef up to 5 tiles that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Slow Setting
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 12 seconds and raises your physical resistance by 15% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Unhurried Shell
fusions.desc: While you are at full health, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
